results.title: Return window for full-price items
results.question: How long do I have to return a full-price grinder?

attempts.answer: Full-price items can be returned within 30 days of delivery.

results.title: Return window for sale items
results.question: I bought a kettle on sale. How long do I have to return it?

attempts.answer: You can return it within 30 days of delivery.

results.title: Gift cards are non-refundable
results.question: Can I get a refund on a gift card?

attempts.answer: Gift cards are non-refundable.

results.title: Refund timing
results.question: When will I get my money back after I return an item?

attempts.answer: Refunds reach your original payment method within 5-7 business days after the item arrives.

results.title: Standard shipping fee
results.question: What does standard shipping cost?

attempts.answer: Standard shipping is $5.

results.title: Free shipping threshold
results.question: Is there a minimum order for free shipping?

attempts.answer: Standard shipping is free on orders over $50.

results.title: Express shipping fee
results.question: How much is express shipping?

results.title: Grinder warranty length
results.question: What warranty comes with a grinder?

attempts.answer: Grinders and espresso machines have a 1 year warranty.
